Only the lower triangle is read; the\n    // strictly upper triangle of the result is zero.\n    if (n == 0) return true;\n    ensureDeviceBuffers(n);\n    const int N = (int)n;\n    const int P = (N + NB - 1) / NB;\n    double* hA = A.data();\n    auto pk = [&](int p) { return p * NB; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfje2AjkgY6Zw7mwaj9nN","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cholesky code in `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` now runs on the GPU with CUDA. It validates at every size I tried, and at n=8192 the timed decomposition went from minutes on the CPU to 330 ms.\n\n| n | Original (1 CPU core) | CUDA (one RTX 3090) |\n|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 29 ms | 2 ms |\n| 2048 | 2128 ms | 13 ms |\n| 8192 | — | 330 ms (~555 GFLOPS) |\n| 16384 | — | 2518 ms (~582 GFLOPS) |\n\nAt large sizes it runs at about the card's maximum double-precision speed (roughly 556 GFLOPS at base clock), so further gains on one GPU would be small. At the default n=512 the time is mostly fixed launch and copy overhead. The 2048 baseline is from building and running the original code here; I didn't run the original at 8192 or 16384.\n\n**How it works**\n- **Algorithm:** the matrix is processed in 64-column strips. Each strip's small diagonal block is factored on the GPU, the rows below it are solved, and then the rest of the matrix is updated. That last update is almost all of the work and gets the most optimised kernel.\n- **Overlap:** the next strip is prepared on a separate high-priority stream while the big update is still running.\n- **Copies:** only the lower triangle is sent to and from the GPU. Finished rows are copied back while computation continues, and the CPU zeroes the upper triangle in the meantime.\n- **Error handling:** the \"not positive definite at diagonal element j\" error is kept. The GPU records the first failing element, the remaining kernels stop, and the function returns false as before.\n- **Timing:** the timed section includes copying the matrix to the GPU and back. Setup (memory allocation, pinning the host buffer, creating streams) happens before the timer starts.\n- **Generation and validation:** both untimed O(n³) steps now run on the GPU so large sizes are practical. Generation reproduces the original CPU matrix bit-for-bit; I confirmed this for n = 512, 1000 and 1024. For sizes not divisible by 4 it can differ in the last bit, because GCC compiles the original loop slightly differently there.\n\n**Correctness:** validation passes for n = 1, 63, 64, 65, 100, 512, 1000, 2048, 3000, 4097, 8192 and 16384. Results differ from the original only by rounding, because the sums are added in a different order. So the `-r` hash is not identical, but the printed values agree to about 15 significant digits. Errors stay well below the 1e‑6 limit (at most about 4e‑8 relative, at n=8192).\n\n**Untested:** I couldn't trigger the not-positive-definite path, because the generated matrices are always positive definite.\n\n**Build:** `CMakeLists.txt` now enables CUDA, compiles `cholesky.cpp` as CUDA, targets the local GPU type and defaults to a Release build. The executable is still called `cholesky`. No new files or libraries were added; the custom kernels don't use cuBLAS or cuSOLVER.\n\nIt uses one GPU. The machine has four RTX 3090s, but splitting the work across them would mean sending data between cards over a slow PCIe link (about 12 GB/s measured) on every strip, so I left that out."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":413,"cache_read_input_tokens":66570,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":413},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"348c82af-4f6f-472f-ba3c-3602dba26357","uuid":"6bc8c4fb-8446-45bc-8b77-a35971467427","timestamp":"2026-10-05T19:26:02.908Z","request_id":"req_011Cfje2APv8ChSskSWeiKX7"}
